description: This file is a C++ source file that implements JavaScript bindings and message handling for a WebKit-based browser environment, involving embedding JavaScript code as string constants and interfacing with JavaScript through the WebKit API.

methods.name: JSStringToString
methods.description: Converts a JavaScript string reference (JSStringRef) to a C++ std::string.

methods.name: JSStringToB64WKString
methods.description: Converts a JSStringRef to a WKStringRef containing its Base64-encoded representation.

methods.name: B64WKStringToJSString
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 WKStringRef to a JSStringRef containing the original string.

methods.name: OnBridgeQuery
methods.description: Handles a message from JavaScript to query the bridge.

methods.name: OnCreateBridgeObject
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript object that serves as a bridge for messaging.

methods.name: CallBridge
methods.description: Calls a JavaScript bridge function with a given payload.

methods.name: InjectJS
methods.description: Injects JavaScript code into the main frame of a WebKit page.

methods.name: HandleMessageToPage
methods.description: Handles messages sent from the page based on message name, dispatching to appropriate JavaScript code.
